<script>
  var isCookieJar = true;

  class FlutterJSBridge {
    constructor() {
      this.init();
    }

    init() {
      if (window.flutter_inappwebview) {
        this.isReady = true;
        this.CookieJar();
      } else {
        window.addEventListener('flutterInAppWebViewPlatformReady', () => {
          this.isReady = true;
          this.CookieJar();
        });
      }
    }

    async CookieJar() {
      try {
        await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('CookieJar', isCookieJar);
      } catch (error) {}
    }

    async log(message) {
      try {
        return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('log', String(message));
      } catch (error) {
        return false;
      }
    }

    async showToast(message) {
      try {
        return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('showToast', String(message));
      } catch (error) {
        return false;
      }
    }
  }

  class Http {
    async Get(url, headers, followRedirects) {
      try {
        return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler(
          'http',
          'get',
          url,
          '',
          JSON.stringify(headers || {}),
          followRedirects !== false,
          ''
        );
      } catch (error) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    async Post(url, headers, body, contentType, followRedirects) {
      try {
        return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler(
          'http',
          'post',
          url,
          body,
          JSON.stringify(headers || {}),
          followRedirects !== false,
          contentType || 'application/json'
        );
      } catch (error) {
        return null;
      }
    }
  }

  class Cache {
    async get(key) {
      try {
        return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('cache.get', key);
      } catch (error) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    async set(key, value) {
      try {
        return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('cache.set', key, value);
      } catch (error) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    async remove(key) {
      try {
        return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('cache.remove', key);
      } catch (error) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    async getLoginInfo() {
      return await this.get('LoginInfo');
    }

    async putLoginInfo(info) {
      return await this.set('LoginInfo', info);
    }
  }
</script>

<script>
  const flutterBridge = new FlutterJSBridge();
  const http = new Http();
  const cache = new Cache();

  const DEFAULTS = {
    aiEndpoint: 'https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions',
    aiModel: 'gpt-4.1-mini',
    proxyEndpoint: 'http://5.45.99.149:8075/tts',
    narratorVoice: 'zh-CN-YunyiMultilingualNeural'
  };
  const AI_ANALYSIS_TIMEOUT = 14000;
  const ANALYSIS_BATCH_DELAY = 15;
  const MAX_ANALYSIS_BATCH_ITEMS = 3;
  const MAX_CONCURRENT_ANALYSIS_BATCHES = 3;

  const VOICE_POOLS = {
    female: {
      child: ['zh-CN-XiaoshuangNeural'],
      teen: ['zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural', 'zh-CN-XiaomengNeural', 'zh-CN-XiaoyanNeural', 'zh-CN-XiaoniNeural'],

      young: ['zh-CN-YunxiNeural', 'zh-CN-YunfengNeural', 'zh-CN-YunzeNeural', 'zh-CN-YunhaoNeural', 'zh-CN-YunjieNeural', 'zh-CN-YunjianNeural', 'zh-CN-YunyangNeural'],
      middle: ['zh-CN-YunzeNeural', 'zh-CN-YunyeNeural', 'zh-CN-YunfengNeural', 'zh-CN-YunjieNeural', 'zh-CN-YunjianNeural', 'zh-CN-YunyangNeural'],
      senior: ['zh-CN-YunyeNeural', 'zh-CN-YunzeNeural', 'zh-CN-YunjieNeural', 'zh-CN-YunjianNeural', 'zh-CN-YunyangNeural'],
      unknown: ['zh-CN-YunxiNeural', 'zh-CN-YunzeNeural', 'zh-CN-YunhaoNeural', 'zh-CN-YunjieNeural', 'zh-CN-YunjianNeural', 'zh-CN-YunyangNeural']
    },
    unknown: {
      child: ['zh-CN-XiaoyouNeural', 'zh-CN-YunxiaNeural'],
      teen: ['zh-CN-XiaoshuangNeural', 'zh-CN-YunxiaNeural'],
      young: ['zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural', 'zh-CN-YunxiNeural'],
      middle: ['zh-CN-XiaomoNeural', 'zh-CN-YunzeNeural'],
      senior: ['zh-CN-XiaoqiuNeural', 'zh-CN-YunyeNeural'],
      unknown: ['zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural', 'zh-CN-YunxiNeural']
    }
  };

  function parseObject(value, fallback) {
    if (!value) return fallback;
    if (typeof value === 'object') return value;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(value);
    } catch (error) {
      return fallback;
    }
  }

  async function readSettings() {
    const info = parseObject(await cache.getLoginInfo(), {});
    const selectedModel = String((await cache.get('ai_selected_model')) || '').trim();
    const settings = {
      aiEndpoint: String(info['AI接口'] || DEFAULTS.aiEndpoint).trim(),
      aiKey: String(info['AI密钥'] || '').trim(),
      aiModel: selectedModel || String(info['AI模型'] || DEFAULTS.aiModel).trim(),
      proxyEndpoint: String(info['TTS中转'] || DEFAULTS.proxyEndpoint).trim(),
      narratorVoice: DEFAULTS.narratorVoice,
      aiEnabled: false
    };
    settings.aiEnabled = (await cache.get('ai_role_enabled')) === 'true';
    return settings;
  }

  function normalizeEndpoint(endpoint) {
    let url = String(endpoint || '').trim().replace(/\/+$/, '');
    if (!url) return DEFAULTS.aiEndpoint;
    if (/\/chat\/completions$/i.test(url)) return url;
    if (/\/v1$/i.test(url)) return url + '/chat/completions';
    return url + '/v1/chat/completions';
  }

  function normalizeModelsEndpoint(endpoint) {
    let url = String(endpoint || '').trim().replace(/\/+$/, '');
    if (!url) return 'https://api.openai.com/v1/models';
    url = url.replace(/\/chat\/completions$/i, '');
    if (/\/v1$/i.test(url)) return url + '/models';
    return url + '/v1/models';
  }

  function aiFingerprint(settings) {
    return hashText(settings.aiEndpoint + '|' + settings.aiModel + '|' + settings.aiKey.slice(-8));
  }

  function responsePayload(response) {
    return parseObject(response && (response.data || response.body || response), {});
  }

  function responseError(response, payload) {
    const message = payload && payload.error
      ? (payload.error.message || payload.error.code || JSON.stringify(payload.error))
      : '';
    return message || ('HTTP ' + (response ? response.statusCode : '无响应'));
  }

  async function requestAiChat(settings, body) {
    const headers = {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + settings.aiKey
    };
    let response = await http.Post(
      normalizeEndpoint(settings.aiEndpoint),
      headers,
      JSON.stringify(body),
      'application/json',
      true
    );
    let payload = responsePayload(response);

    if ((!response || Number(response.statusCode || 200) >= 400) && body.response_format) {
      const compatibleBody = {...body};
      delete compatibleBody.response_format;
      response = await http.Post(
        normalizeEndpoint(settings.aiEndpoint),
        headers,
        JSON.stringify(compatibleBody),
        'application/json',
        true
      );
      payload = responsePayload(response);
    }

    if (!response || Number(response.statusCode || 200) >= 400) {
      throw new Error(responseError(response, payload));
    }
    const choice = payload.choices && payload.choices[0];
    const message = choice && choice.message;
    const toolArguments = message && message.tool_calls && message.tool_calls[0] &&
      message.tool_calls[0].function && message.tool_calls[0].function.arguments;
    let content = message
      ? (message.content || message.text || message.output_text || toolArguments || message.reasoning_content)
      : (choice && choice.text || payload.output_text || payload.content || payload.text || payload.response);
    if (Array.isArray(content)) {
      content = content.map(item => typeof item === 'string'
        ? item
        : item && (item.text || item.content || item.value) || '').filter(Boolean).join('\n');
    } else if (content && typeof content === 'object') {
      content = JSON.stringify(content);
    }
    if (!content) throw new Error(responseError(response, payload));
    return content;
  }

  async function withTimeout(promise, milliseconds, message) {
    let timer;
    try {
      return await Promise.race([
        promise,
        new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error(message)), milliseconds);
        })
      ]);
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }

  async function fetchAiModels() {
    const settings = await readSettings();
    if (!settings.aiEndpoint || !settings.aiKey) {
      await flutterBridge.showToast('请先填写 AI接口 和 AI密钥');
      return;
    }

    await cache.set('ai_role_enabled', 'false');
    try {
      const response = await http.Get(
        normalizeModelsEndpoint(settings.aiEndpoint),
        {'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + settings.aiKey, 'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
        true
      );
      const payload = responsePayload(response);
      if (!response || Number(response.statusCode || 200) >= 400) {
        throw new Error(responseError(response, payload));
      }
      const models = (Array.isArray(payload.data) ? payload.data : [])
        .map(item => typeof item === 'string' ? item : item.id)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .sort()
        .slice(0, 60);
      if (!models.length) throw new Error('接口没有返回模型列表');

      await cache.set('ai_model_list', JSON.stringify(models));
      const info = parseObject(await cache.getLoginInfo(), {});
      const selectedModel = String((await cache.get('ai_selected_model')) || info['AI模型'] || '');
      if (!models.includes(selectedModel)) {
        info['AI模型'] = models[0];
        await cache.set('ai_selected_model', models[0]);
      } else {
        info['AI模型'] = selectedModel;
        await cache.set('ai_selected_model', selectedModel);
      }
      await cache.putLoginInfo(JSON.stringify(info));
      await flutterBridge.showToast('获取到 ' + models.length + ' 个模型，重新打开设置即可选择');
    } catch (error) {
      await cache.set('ai_last_status', '获取模型失败：' + error.message);
      await flutterBridge.showToast('获取模型失败：' + error.message);
    }
  }

  async function setAiModel(model) {
    const info = parseObject(await cache.getLoginInfo(), {});
    info['AI模型'] = model;
    await cache.putLoginInfo(JSON.stringify(info));
    await cache.set('ai_selected_model', model);
    await cache.set('ai_role_enabled', 'false');
    await cache.set('ai_last_status', '模型已选择，尚未测试');
    await flutterBridge.showToast('已选择模型：' + model);
  }

  async function showAiStatus() {
    const settings = await readSettings();
    const enabled = await cache.get('ai_role_enabled');
    const status = await cache.get('ai_last_status');
    await flutterBridge.showToast(
      (enabled === 'true' ? 'AI已启用' : 'AI未启用') + '｜模型：' +
      (settings.aiModel || '未选择') + (status ? '｜' + status : '')
    );
  }

  async function testAndEnableAI() {
    const settings = await readSettings();
    if (!settings.aiEndpoint || !settings.aiKey || !settings.aiModel) {
      await flutterBridge.showToast('请先填写接口、密钥并选择模型');
      return;
    }
    await cache.set('ai_role_enabled', 'false');
    try {
      const content = await requestAiChat(settings, {
        model: settings.aiModel,
        temperature: 0,
        response_format: {type: 'json_object'},
        messages: [
          {role: 'system', content: '只输出严格 JSON。'},
          {role: 'user', content: '返回 {"ok":true,"speaker":"小满","gender":"female","age":"child"}'}
        ]
      });
      const parsed = parseObject(stripJsonFence(content), null);
      if (!parsed) throw new Error('模型未返回 JSON');
      await cache.set('ai_role_enabled', 'true');
      await cache.remove('ai_disabled_notice');
      await cache.remove('ai_working_notice');
      await cache.remove('ai_last_read_error');
      await cache.set('ai_last_status', '连接测试成功');
      await flutterBridge.showToast('AI连接成功，角色识别已启用');
    } catch (error) {
      await cache.set('ai_last_status', '测试失败：' + error.message);
      await flutterBridge.showToast('AI测试失败：' + error.message);
    }
  }

  function hashText(text) {
    let hash = 2166136261;
    const input = String(text || '');
    for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
      hash ^= input.charCodeAt(i);
      hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619);
    }
    return (hash >>> 0).toString(36);
  }

  function stripJsonFence(text) {
    const raw = String(text || '').trim();
    const fenced = raw.match(/```(?:json)?\s*([\s\S]*?)```/i);
    if (fenced) return fenced[1].trim();
    const start = raw.indexOf('{');
    const end = raw.lastIndexOf('}');
    if (start >= 0 && end > start) return raw.slice(start, end + 1);
    return raw;
  }

  function parseAiPayload(content) {
    if (content && typeof content === 'object' && !Array.isArray(content)) return content;
    if (Array.isArray(content)) {
      const blocks = content.map(item => {
        if (typeof item === 'string') return item;
        return item && (item.text || item.content || item.value) || '';
      }).filter(Boolean);
      if (blocks.length) content = blocks.join('\n');
      else return content;
    }
    let raw = String(content || '').trim();
    const fenced = raw.match(/```(?:json)?\s*([\s\S]*?)```/i);
    if (fenced) raw = fenced[1].trim();
    try {
      return JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch (error) {}

    const candidates = [];
    let start = -1;
    let stack = [];
    let inString = false;
    let escaped = false;
    for (let index = 0; index < raw.length; index++) {
      const char = raw[index];
      if (inString) {
        if (escaped) escaped = false;
        else if (char === '\\') escaped = true;
        else if (char === '"') inString = false;
        continue;
      }
      if (char === '"') {
        inString = true;
        continue;
      }
      if (char === '{' || char === '[') {
        if (!stack.length) start = index;
        stack.push(char);
      } else if ((char === '}' || char === ']') && stack.length) {
        const opener = stack[stack.length - 1];
        if ((opener === '{' && char === '}') || (opener === '[' && char === ']')) stack.pop();
        else {
          stack = [];
          start = -1;
          continue;
        }
        if (!stack.length && start >= 0) {
          try {
            candidates.push(JSON.parse(raw.slice(start, index + 1)));
          } catch (error) {}
          start = -1;
        }
      }
    }
    for (let index = candidates.length - 1; index >= 0; index--) {
      const candidate = candidates[index];
      if (Array.isArray(candidate)) return candidate;
      if (candidate && typeof candidate === 'object') {
        if (candidate.lines || candidate.dialogues || candidate.results || candidate.items ||
          candidate.data || candidate.result || candidate.analysis || candidate.output) return candidate;
      }
    }
    return candidates.length ? candidates[candidates.length - 1] : null;
  }

  function normalizeAiAnalysis(payload) {
    let value = payload;
    for (let depth = 0; depth < 3; depth++) {
      if (typeof value === 'string') value = parseAiPayload(value);
      if (!value || Array.isArray(value)) break;
      const wrapped = value.result || value.data || value.analysis || value.output;
      if (!wrapped || wrapped === value) break;
      if (value.lines || value.dialogues || value.results || value.items) break;
      value = wrapped;
    }

    let lines;
    let narration = {};
    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
      lines = value;
    } else if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
      narration = value.narration || value.narrator || value.prosody || {};
      lines = value.lines || value.dialogues || value.dialogue || value.results ||
        value.items || value.characters || value.roles || value['对白'] || value['对话'] ||
        value['角色分析'] || value['识别结果'] || value['结果'];
      if (!lines && (value.speaker || value.role || value.gender || value.age ||
        value['角色'] || value['说话人'] || value['性别'] || value['年龄'])) lines = [value];
      if (!lines) {
        const numericKeys = Object.keys(value).filter(key => /^\d+$/.test(key));
        if (numericKeys.length) lines = numericKeys.sort((a, b) => Number(a) - Number(b)).map(key => value[key]);
      }
      if (!lines) {
        const entries = Object.entries(value).filter(([, item]) => item && typeof item === 'object' && !Array.isArray(item));
        const roleEntries = entries.filter(([, item]) => item.gender || item.age || item['性别'] || item['年龄']);
        if (roleEntries.length) lines = roleEntries.map(([speaker, item]) => ({speaker: speaker, ...item}));
      }
      if (!lines) {
        const queue = Object.values(value).filter(item => item && typeof item === 'object');
        while (queue.length && !lines) {
          const item = queue.shift();
          if (Array.isArray(item) && item.some(entry => entry && typeof entry === 'object')) lines = item;
          else if (item && typeof item === 'object') queue.push(...Object.values(item).filter(entry => entry && typeof entry === 'object'));
        }
      }
    }

    if (lines && !Array.isArray(lines) && typeof lines === 'object') lines = Object.values(lines);
    if (!Array.isArray(lines)) return null;
    return {
      narration: narration,
      lines: lines.map((item, index) => ({
        ...(item && item.profile ? item.profile : {}),
        ...(item || {}),
        id: Number(item && (item.id || item.line_id || item.index)) || index + 1
      }))
    };
  }

  function normalizeGender(value) {
    const text = String(value || '').toLowerCase();
    if (text === 'male' || text.includes('男')) return 'male';
    if (text === 'female' || text.includes('女')) return 'female';
    return 'unknown';
  }

  function normalizeAge(value) {
    const text = String(value || '').toLowerCase();
    if (text === 'child' || /儿童|幼儿|小孩|童/.test(text)) return 'child';
    if (text === 'teen' || /少年|少女|青少年/.test(text)) return 'teen';
    if (text === 'young' || /青年|年轻/.test(text)) return 'young';
    if (text === 'middle' || /中年|成熟/.test(text)) return 'middle';
    if (text === 'senior' || /老年|老人|年长/.test(text)) return 'senior';
    return 'unknown';
  }

  function normalizeEmotion(value) {
    const text = String(value || '').toLowerCase();
    const allowed = ['neutral', 'calm', 'happy', 'sad', 'angry', 'nervous', 'excited', 'serious', 'tender'];
    return allowed.includes(text) ? text : 'neutral';
  }

  function normalizeIntensity(value) {
    const number = Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(number) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, number)) : 0.35;
  }

  function normalizeProsody(result) {
    return {
      emotion: normalizeEmotion(result && (result.emotion || result['情绪'] || result['语气'])),
      intensity: normalizeIntensity(result && (result.intensity || result['强度'] || result['情绪强度']))
    };
  }

  function normalizePlainAiAnalysis(content, dialogueCount) {
    const raw = String(content || '').replace(/<think>[\s\S]*?<\/think>/gi, '').trim();
    if (!raw) return null;
    const chunks = raw.split(/\n+/).map(item => item.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    const lines = [];
    for (const chunk of chunks) {
      const speakerMatch = chunk.match(/(?:speaker|role|说话人|说话角色|角色|人物|姓名)\s*[:：=]\s*["“]?([^,，;；|\n}"”]+)/i);
      const genderMatch = chunk.match(/(?:gender|sex|性别)\s*[:：=]\s*["“]?([^,，;；|\n}"”]+)/i);
      const ageMatch = chunk.match(/(?:age|age_group|年龄段?|年龄层)\s*[:：=]\s*["“]?([^,，;；|\n}"”]+)/i);
      const emotionMatch = chunk.match(/(?:emotion|情绪|语气)\s*[:：=]\s*["“]?([^,，;；|\n}"”]+)/i);
      if (!speakerMatch && !genderMatch && !ageMatch) continue;
      lines.push({
        id: lines.length + 1,
        speaker: speakerMatch ? speakerMatch[1].trim() : '',
        gender: genderMatch ? genderMatch[1].trim() : 'unknown',
        age: ageMatch ? ageMatch[1].trim() : 'unknown',
        emotion: emotionMatch ? emotionMatch[1].trim() : 'neutral',
        intensity: 0.3,
        age_evidence: ageMatch ? ageMatch[1].trim() : '无'
      });
      if (lines.length >= dialogueCount) break;
    }
    return lines.length ? {narration: {}, lines: lines} : null;
  }

  function splitSpeechSegments(text) {
    const pairs = {'“': '”', '「': '」', '『': '』', '"': '"'};
    const result = [];
    let type = 'narrator';
    let closing = '';
    let buffer = '';

    function pushBuffer() {
      const value = buffer.trim();
      if (value) result.push({type: type, text: value});
      buffer = '';
    }

    for (const char of String(text || '')) {
      if (type === 'narrator' && pairs[char]) {
        pushBuffer();
        type = 'dialogue';
        closing = pairs[char];
      } else if (type === 'dialogue' && char === closing) {
        pushBuffer();
        type = 'narrator';
        closing = '';
      } else {
        buffer += char;
      }
    }
    pushBuffer();

    const merged = [];
    for (const item of result) {
      const previous = merged[merged.length - 1];
      if (previous && previous.type === item.type) previous.text += item.text;
      else merged.push(item);
    }
    return merged.length ? merged : [{type: 'narrator', text: String(text || '').trim()}];
  }

  function inferSpeaker(context) {
    const value = String(context || '');
    const pattern = /(?:^|[，。！？；、\s])([\u4e00-\u9fa5]{1,4}?)(?:急忙|轻声|低声|大声|冷冷地|笑着|哭着|突然|认真|温和地|沉声|缓缓|平静地)?(?:说道|说|问道|问|喊道|喊|答道|答|叫道|叫)/g;
    let match;
    let speaker = '';
    while ((match = pattern.exec(value))) speaker = match[1];
    if (/解释|回应|补充|电话|一头|接着|继续/.test(speaker)) return '未命名角色';
    if (/^(她|女孩|姑娘|女子)$/.test(speaker)) return '女性角色';
    if (/^(他|男孩|男人|男子)$/.test(speaker)) return '男性角色';
    return speaker || '未命名角色';
  }

  function localDialogueProfile(segment, segments, index) {
    const before = segments[index - 1] && segments[index - 1].type === 'narrator'
      ? segments[index - 1].text.slice(-100)
      : '';
    const after = segments[index + 1] && segments[index + 1].type === 'narrator'
      ? segments[index + 1].text.slice(0, 100)
      : '';
    const context = before + ' ' + segment.text + ' ' + after;
    let gender = 'unknown';
    let age = 'unknown';

    if (/她|姑娘|小姐|女士|母亲|妈妈|姐姐|妹妹|妻子|奶奶|婆婆/.test(context)) gender = 'female';
    if (/他|男人|先生|父亲|爸爸|哥哥|弟弟|丈夫|爷爷|老头/.test(context)) gender = 'male';
    if (/婴儿|幼儿|小朋友|小孩|孩子|童声/.test(context)) age = 'child';
    else if (/少年|少女|中学生|十[三四五六七八九]岁/.test(context)) age = 'teen';
    else if (/老人|老者|爷爷|奶奶|老头|老太/.test(context)) age = 'senior';
    else if (/中年|大叔|阿姨|父亲|母亲/.test(context)) age = 'middle';
    else age = 'young';

    // 只看紧邻当前引号的小句，避免把上一句的“某某说道”套到下一位角色身上。
    const afterClause = after.split(/[。！？；]/)[0] || '';
    const beforeParts = before.split(/[。！？；]/);
    const beforeClause = beforeParts[beforeParts.length - 1] || '';
    const afterSpeaker = inferSpeaker(afterClause);
    const nearbySpeaker = afterSpeaker !== '未命名角色'
      ? afterSpeaker
      : inferSpeaker(beforeClause);

    return {
      type: 'dialogue',
      speaker: nearbySpeaker,
      gender: gender,
      age: age,
      confidence: 0.35
    };
  }

  function normalizeDialogueProfile(result, fallback) {
    const speaker = String(result.speaker || result.role || result.name ||
      result['角色'] || result['说话人'] || result['人物'] || result['姓名'] || '').trim();
    const prosody = normalizeProsody(result);
    return {
      type: 'dialogue',
      speaker: speaker || fallback.speaker,
      gender: normalizeGender(result.gender || result.sex || result['性别'] || fallback.gender),
      age: normalizeAge(result.age || result.age_group || result['年龄'] || result['年龄段'] || fallback.age),
      emotion: prosody.emotion,
      intensity: prosody.intensity,
      confidence: Number(result.confidence || fallback.confidence || 0)
    };
  }

  function hasStrictChildEvidence(value) {
    const text = String(value || '');
    const number = text.match(/(?:^|\D)(\d{1,2})\s*岁/);
    if (number && Number(number[1]) <= 12) return true;
    return /(?:一|二|三|四|五|六|七|八|九|十|十一|十二)岁|婴儿|幼儿|幼童|小学生|儿童|男童|女童|小男孩|小女孩/.test(text);
  }

  function stabilizeCharacterProfile(profile, line, roster) {
    const known = roster[profile.speaker];
    if (known) {
      if (known.gender && known.gender !== 'unknown') profile.gender = known.gender;
      if (known.age && known.age !== 'unknown') profile.age = known.age;
    }
    if (profile.age === 'child' && !(known && known.age === 'child') &&
      !hasStrictChildEvidence(line.age_evidence || line['年龄依据'])) {
      profile.age = known && known.age ? known.age : 'unknown';
    }
    return profile;
  }

  function canonicalSpeakerName(speaker, roster) {
    const name = String(speaker || '').trim();
    if (!name || roster[name]) return name;
    const base = name.replace(/(?:先生|女士|小姐|老师|医生|主任|经理|老板|同学)$/g, '');
    if (base && roster[base]) return base;
    const matches = Object.keys(roster).filter(existing => {
      const existingBase = existing.replace(/(?:先生|女士|小姐|老师|医生|主任|经理|老板|同学)$/g, '');
      return base.length >= 2 && existingBase === base;
    });
    return matches.length === 1 ? matches[0] : name;
  }

  function isChapterHeading(text) {
    return /^\s*(?:第[零一二三四五六七八九十百千万两\d]+[章节回卷]|序章|楔子|尾声|番外)/.test(String(text || ''));
  }

  async function readChapterMemory(text) {
    let memory = parseObject(await cache.get('ai_chapter_memory_v4'), {});
    if (!memory || typeof memory !== 'object' || isChapterHeading(text)) memory = {};
    return {
      text: String(memory.text || '').slice(-30000),
      dialogues: Array.isArray(memory.dialogues) ? memory.dialogues.slice(-80) : []
    };
  }

  function hasSpeakerCue(item) {
    const context = String(item.before || '') + ' ' + String(item.after || '');
    return /(?:说|问|喊|答|叫|道|解释|回应|补充|嘀咕|叹气|开口|接着|继续)/.test(context);
  }

  function isGenericSpeaker(speaker) {
    return /^(?:未命名角色|男性角色|女性角色|说话人|男人|女人|男子|女子|男孩|女孩|他|她|角色\d*)$/.test(String(speaker || ''));
  }

  function keepPreviousSpeaker(profile, line, item, previousProfile, roster) {
    if (!previousProfile || hasSpeakerCue(item)) return profile;
    const sameAsPrevious = line.same_as_previous ?? line['承接上一句'] ?? line['与上一句同一人'];
    const namedInsideDialogue = profile.speaker && String(item.text || '').includes(profile.speaker) &&
      !/(?:我是|我叫|名字叫)/.test(String(item.text || ''));
    const unknownNewSpeaker = profile.speaker && profile.speaker !== previousProfile.speaker && !roster[profile.speaker];
    const shouldContinue = sameAsPrevious === true || namedInsideDialogue ||
      (sameAsPrevious !== false && (isGenericSpeaker(profile.speaker) || namedInsideDialogue || unknownNewSpeaker));
    if (!shouldContinue) return profile;
    return {
      type: 'dialogue',
      speaker: previousProfile.speaker,
      gender: previousProfile.gender,
      age: previousProfile.age,
      emotion: profile.emotion,
      intensity: profile.intensity,
      confidence: Math.max(Number(profile.confidence || 0), Number(previousProfile.confidence || 0))
    };
  }

  async function updateChapterMemory(text, rendered, source) {
    const memory = await readChapterMemory(text);
    const value = String(text || '').trim();
    if (value && !memory.text.endsWith(value)) memory.text = (memory.text + '\n' + value).trim().slice(-30000);
    if (source === 'ai') {
      for (const item of rendered) {
        if (item.profile.type !== 'dialogue') continue;
        memory.dialogues.push({
          speaker: item.profile.speaker,
          gender: item.profile.gender,
          age: item.profile.age,
          text: item.text
        });
      }
      memory.dialogues = memory.dialogues.slice(-80);
    }
    await cache.set('ai_chapter_memory_v4', JSON.stringify(memory));
  }

  async function analyzeDialoguesWithAI(text, segments, settings) {
    const dialogues = [];
    const fallbacks = {};
    segments.forEach((segment, index) => {
      if (segment.type !== 'dialogue') return;
      const id = dialogues.length + 1;
      const before = segments[index - 1] && segments[index - 1].type === 'narrator'
        ? segments[index - 1].text.slice(-120)
        : '';
      const after = segments[index + 1] && segments[index + 1].type === 'narrator'
        ? segments[index + 1].text.slice(0, 120)
        : '';
      dialogues.push({id: id, text: segment.text, before: before, after: after, segmentIndex: index});
      fallbacks[id] = localDialogueProfile(segment, segments, index);
    });

    if (!dialogues.length) return {};
    fallbacks._source = 'local';
    if (!settings.aiEnabled || !settings.aiKey) return fallbacks;

    const chapterMemory = await readChapterMemory(text);
    const dialogueHistory = chapterMemory.dialogues.slice(-3);
    let previousProfile = dialogueHistory.length ? dialogueHistory[dialogueHistory.length - 1] : null;
    if (previousProfile) {
      for (const item of dialogues) {
        if (!hasSpeakerCue(item)) {
          fallbacks[item.id] = {
            type: 'dialogue',
            speaker: previousProfile.speaker,
            gender: previousProfile.gender,
            age: previousProfile.age,
            emotion: 'neutral',
            intensity: 0.3,
            confidence: previousProfile.confidence || 0.5
          };
        }
      }
    }
    const cacheContext = previousProfile ? previousProfile.speaker : '';
    const cacheKey = 'ai_cast_v7_' + hashText(text + '|' + cacheContext);
    const cached = parseObject(await cache.get(cacheKey), null);
    if (cached) {
      cached._source = 'ai';
      return cached;
    }

    const roster = parseObject(await cache.get('ai_character_roster_v4'), {});
    // 只携带角色识别真正需要的字段，避免角色表越积越长拖慢模型。
    const rosterList = Object.values(roster).slice(-12).map(item => ({
      speaker: item.speaker,
      gender: item.gender,
      age: item.age
    }));
    const compactHistory = dialogueHistory.slice(-3).map(item => ({
      speaker: item.speaker,
      gender: item.gender,
      age: item.age,
      text: String(item.text || '').slice(0, 80)
    }));
    const prompt = [
      '你是中文小说配音助手，只分析当前几个相邻小段，不做整章分析。旁白无需分配角色。',
      '请判断每条对白是谁说的，并推断性别、年龄层和当前情绪。相同角色必须使用相同 speaker 名称。',
      '优先从已有角色表中选择；原文没有姓名时，可使用稳定称呼，例如“母亲”“少年”“店主”，不要每句创造新角色。',
      '重点判断当前对白是否承接上一条对白。同一个人连续说多段引号内容时，same_as_previous 必须为 true，并沿用上一条 speaker。',
      '对白里提到的人名不一定是说话人。例如“张羽没有训练”不能据此认定张羽正在说话。只有明确换人或上下文确实轮到另一角色时才更换 speaker。',
      '年龄必须按角色实际年龄判断：child=0至12岁，teen=13至17岁，young=18至35岁，middle=36至59岁，senior=60岁以上。',
      '必须在 age_evidence 中写出剧情里的年龄依据；没有明确依据就返回 unknown，严禁仅凭语气、称呼别人为孩子或一句话内容判断为 child。',
      '同时判断本段旁白氛围和每条对白的情绪。emotion 只能是 neutral|calm|happy|sad|angry|nervous|excited|serious|tender，intensity 为0到1；不确定时使用 neutral 和0.3，禁止夸张。',
      '只返回严格 JSON：',
      '{"narration":{"emotion":"neutral","intensity":0.3},"lines":[{"id":1,"speaker":"角色名或稳定称呼","gender":"male|female|unknown","age":"child|teen|young|middle|senior|unknown","age_evidence":"原文依据或无","emotion":"neutral","intensity":0.3,"same_as_previous":false,"confidence":0.0}]}',
      '',
      '已有角色表：' + JSON.stringify(rosterList),
      '最近已确认的对白角色：' + JSON.stringify(compactHistory),
      '当前相邻段落：' + String(text || '').slice(0, 700),
      '待识别对白：' + JSON.stringify(dialogues.map(item => ({
        id: item.id,
        before: item.before,
        text: item.text,
        after: item.after
      })))
    ].join('\n');

    const body = {
      model: settings.aiModel,
      temperature: 0,
      max_tokens: Math.min(900, Math.max(350, dialogues.length * 110)),
      response_format: {type: 'json_object'},
      messages: [
        {role: 'system', content: '你只输出严格 JSON，保持角色名称稳定。'},
        {role: 'user', content: prompt}
      ]
    };

    let lastRawContent = '';
    try {
      const parsed = await withTimeout(
        (async () => {
          let content = await requestAiChat(settings, body);
          lastRawContent = String(content || '');
          const analysis = normalizeAiAnalysis(parseAiPayload(content)) ||
            normalizePlainAiAnalysis(content, dialogues.length);
          return analysis;
        })(),
        AI_ANALYSIS_TIMEOUT,
        'AI响应较慢'
      );
      if (!parsed || !parsed.lines.length) {
        await flutterBridge.log('AI格式不标准，已沿用角色记忆');
        await cache.set('ai_last_status', '已沿用角色记忆');
        return fallbacks;
      }

      const profiles = {};
      for (const item of dialogues) {
        const line = parsed.lines.find(value => Number(value.id) === item.id) || {};
        let profile = normalizeDialogueProfile(line, fallbacks[item.id]);
        const explicitSpeaker = fallbacks[item.id] && fallbacks[item.id].speaker;
        if (explicitSpeaker && !isGenericSpeaker(explicitSpeaker)) {
          profile.speaker = explicitSpeaker;
        }
        profile.speaker = canonicalSpeakerName(profile.speaker, roster);
        profile = stabilizeCharacterProfile(profile, line, roster);
        profile = keepPreviousSpeaker(profile, line, item, previousProfile, roster);
        profiles[item.id] = profile;
        previousProfile = profile;
        if (profile.speaker && profile.speaker !== '未命名角色') {
          roster[profile.speaker] = {
            speaker: profile.speaker,
            gender: profile.gender,
            age: profile.age
          };
        }
      }

      const rosterKeys = Object.keys(roster);
      if (rosterKeys.length > 60) {
        rosterKeys.slice(0, rosterKeys.length - 60).forEach(key => delete roster[key]);
      }
      await cache.set('ai_character_roster_v4', JSON.stringify(roster));
      profiles._narration = normalizeProsody(parsed.narration);
      profiles._source = 'ai';
      await cache.set(cacheKey, JSON.stringify(profiles));
      return profiles;
    } catch (error) {
      await flutterBridge.log('AI角色识别失败，改用本地判断：' + error.message);
      if (lastRawContent) await cache.set('ai_last_raw_preview', lastRawContent.slice(0, 500));
      await cache.set('ai_last_status', 'AI较慢，已沿用角色记忆');
      const lastError = await cache.get('ai_last_read_error');
      if (lastError !== error.message) {
        await cache.set('ai_last_read_error', error.message);
        await flutterBridge.log('AI识别暂不可用：' + error.message);
      }
      return fallbacks;
    }
  }

  function voicePool(profile) {
    const gender = VOICE_POOLS[profile.gender] ? profile.gender : 'unknown';
    const age = VOICE_POOLS[gender][profile.age] ? profile.age : 'unknown';
    return VOICE_POOLS[gender][age];
  }

  function voiceMatchesProfile(voice, profile) {
    if (!voice) return false;
    const gender = profile.gender === 'male' || profile.gender === 'female'
      ? profile.gender
      : 'unknown';
    if (gender !== 'unknown') {
      const genderVoices = Object.values(VOICE_POOLS[gender]).flat();
      if (!genderVoices.includes(voice)) return false;
    }
    const childVoices = [...VOICE_POOLS.female.child, ...VOICE_POOLS.male.child];
    if (profile.age === 'child') return childVoices.includes(voice);
    if (profile.age !== 'unknown' && childVoices.includes(voice)) return false;
    return true;
  }

  async function resolveVoice(profile, settings) {
    if (profile.type !== 'dialogue') return settings.narratorVoice;

    const voiceMap = parseObject(await cache.get('ai_speaker_voice_map_v4'), {});
    const identity = profile.speaker === '未命名角色'
      ? [profile.speaker, profile.gender, profile.age].join('|')
      : profile.speaker;
    const saved = voiceMap[identity];
    const savedVoice = typeof saved === 'string' ? saved : saved && saved.voice;
    if (voiceMatchesProfile(savedVoice, profile)) return savedVoice;

    const pool = voicePool(profile);
    const used = Object.values(voiceMap).map(item => typeof item === 'string' ? item : item && item.voice).filter(Boolean);
    const start = parseInt(hashText(identity || '角色'), 36) % pool.length;
    let voice = pool[start];
    for (let offset = 0; offset < pool.length; offset++) {
      const candidate = pool[(start + offset) % pool.length];
      if (!used.includes(candidate)) {
        voice = candidate;
        break;
      }
    }
    voiceMap[identity] = {voice: voice, gender: profile.gender, age: profile.age};
    await cache.set('ai_speaker_voice_map_v4', JSON.stringify(voiceMap));
    return voice;
  }

  function speedPercent(speechRate) {
    const number = Number(speechRate);
    if (!Number.isFinite(number)) return 0;
    return Math.max(-50, Math.min(100, Math.round((number - 10) * 10)));
  }

  function emotionAdjustment(profile) {
    const intensity = normalizeIntensity(profile && profile.intensity);
    const adjustments = {
      neutral: {rate: 0, pitch: 0},
      calm: {rate: -3, pitch: 0},
      happy: {rate: 5, pitch: 2},
      sad: {rate: -6, pitch: -2},
      angry: {rate: 7, pitch: 2},
      nervous: {rate: 5, pitch: 1},
      excited: {rate: 8, pitch: 2},
      serious: {rate: -3, pitch: -1},
      tender: {rate: -4, pitch: 1}
    };
    const value = adjustments[normalizeEmotion(profile && profile.emotion)] || adjustments.neutral;
    return {
      rate: Math.round(value.rate * intensity),
      pitch: Math.round(value.pitch * intensity)
    };
  }

  function rateFor(profile, speechRate) {
    return Math.max(-50, Math.min(100, speedPercent(speechRate) + emotionAdjustment(profile).rate));
  }

  function pitchFor(profile) {
    let pitch = 0;
    if (profile.age === 'child') pitch = 2;
    if (profile.age === 'senior') pitch = -2;
    return Math.max(-8, Math.min(8, pitch + emotionAdjustment(profile).pitch));
  }

  function buildProxyRequest(text, speechRate, voice, profile, settings) {
    const endpoint = settings.proxyEndpoint || DEFAULTS.proxyEndpoint;
    const separator = endpoint.includes('?') ? '&' : '?';
    const url = endpoint + separator + [
      't=' + encodeURIComponent(text),
      'v=' + encodeURIComponent(voice),
      'r=' + rateFor(profile, speechRate),
      'p=' + pitchFor(profile)
    ].join('&');

    return {method: 'get', url: url, headers: {}};
  }

  function base64ToBytes(value) {
    const binary = atob(String(value || '').replace(/\s/g, ''));
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
    return bytes;
  }

  function bytesToBase64(bytes) {
    let binary = '';
    const size = 0x8000;
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += size) {
      binary += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, bytes.subarray(i, i + size));
    }
    return btoa(binary);
  }

  function stripId3(bytes) {
    if (bytes.length < 10 || bytes[0] !== 0x49 || bytes[1] !== 0x44 || bytes[2] !== 0x33) return bytes;
    const size = (bytes[6] << 21) | (bytes[7] << 14) | (bytes[8] << 7) | bytes[9];
    const offset = Math.min(bytes.length, size + 10);
    return bytes.subarray(offset);
  }

  function concatAudio(parts) {
    const cleaned = parts.map((part, index) => index === 0 ? part : stripId3(part));
    const total = cleaned.reduce((sum, part) => sum + part.length, 0);
    const output = new Uint8Array(total);
    let offset = 0;
    for (const part of cleaned) {
      output.set(part, offset);
      offset += part.length;
    }
    return output;
  }

  async function fetchAudioPart(item, speechRate, settings) {
    const request = buildProxyRequest(item.text, speechRate, item.voice, item.profile, settings);
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
      const response = await http.Get(request.url, {}, true);
      if (response && Number(response.statusCode || 200) < 400 && response.body) {
        return base64ToBytes(response.body);
      }
      if (attempt === 0) await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 250));
    }
    throw new Error('微软音频请求失败');
  }

  async function buildMultiVoiceRequest(rendered, speechRate, settings, originalText) {
    const merged = [];
    for (const item of rendered) {
      if (!item.text) continue;
      const previous = merged[merged.length - 1];
      if (previous && previous.voice === item.voice &&
        pitchFor(previous.profile) === pitchFor(item.profile) &&
        rateFor(previous.profile, speechRate) === rateFor(item.profile, speechRate)) {
        previous.text += item.text;
      } else {
        merged.push({...item});
      }
    }

    if (merged.length === 1) {
      return buildProxyRequest(merged[0].text, speechRate, merged[0].voice, merged[0].profile, settings);
    }

    try {
      const parts = await Promise.all(
        merged.map(item => fetchAudioPart(item, speechRate, settings))
      );
      return {
        method: 'data',
        url: '',
        headers: {},
        body: bytesToBase64(concatAudio(parts))
      };
    } catch (error) {
      await flutterBridge.log('多角色音频合并失败，整段改用旁白：' + error.message);
      const narrator = {type: 'narrator', speaker: '旁白', gender: 'unknown', age: 'unknown'};
      return buildProxyRequest(originalText, speechRate, settings.narratorVoice, narrator, settings);
    }
  }

  // 把轻阅时光同时预取的小段合并成一次 AI 请求，减少排队和超时。
  let pendingRoleBatch = [];
  let roleBatchTimer = null;
  let activeRoleBatches = 0;
  const rolePreparationInFlight = {};
  let roleBatchFinalizeTail = Promise.resolve();
  let lastFinalizedDialogueProfile = null;

  function scheduleRolePreparation(text, segments, settings) {
    const requestKey = hashText(text + '|' + aiFingerprint(settings));
    if (rolePreparationInFlight[requestKey]) return rolePreparationInFlight[requestKey];

    const preparation = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      pendingRoleBatch.push({text: text, segments: segments, settings: settings, resolve: resolve, reject: reject});
      if (!roleBatchTimer) {
        roleBatchTimer = setTimeout(flushRoleBatch, settings.aiEnabled ? ANALYSIS_BATCH_DELAY : 0);
      }
    });
    rolePreparationInFlight[requestKey] = preparation;
    const clearRequest = () => delete rolePreparationInFlight[requestKey];
    preparation.then(clearRequest, clearRequest);
    return preparation;
  }

  async function flushRoleBatch() {
    roleBatchTimer = null;
    if (!pendingRoleBatch.length) return;
    if (activeRoleBatches >= MAX_CONCURRENT_ANALYSIS_BATCHES) {
      roleBatchTimer = setTimeout(flushRoleBatch, 20);
      return;
    }
    activeRoleBatches += 1;
    // 只合并少量相邻预取段，避免把整章塞给 AI 后变慢或串错角色。
    const batch = pendingRoleBatch.splice(0, MAX_ANALYSIS_BATCH_ITEMS);
    // AI请求可以并行，但结果必须按原文预取顺序落库，否则后一组看不到上一说话人。
    const waitForPreviousFinalize = roleBatchFinalizeTail;
    let finishFinalize;
    roleBatchFinalizeTail = new Promise(resolve => { finishFinalize = resolve; });
    let waitedForFinalize = false;
    // 后面的预取段可同时识别，不再排队累计 14、28、42 秒。
    if (pendingRoleBatch.length && !roleBatchTimer &&
      activeRoleBatches < MAX_CONCURRENT_ANALYSIS_BATCHES) {
      roleBatchTimer = setTimeout(flushRoleBatch, 0);
    }

    try {
      const combinedText = batch.map(item => item.text).join('\n');
      const combinedSegments = [];
      for (let index = 0; index < batch.length; index++) {
        if (index) combinedSegments.push({type: 'narrator', text: '〔段落分隔〕'});
        combinedSegments.push(...batch[index].segments);
      }
      const dialogueProfiles = await analyzeDialoguesWithAI(combinedText, combinedSegments, batch[0].settings);
      await waitForPreviousFinalize;
      waitedForFinalize = true;
      if (dialogueProfiles._source === 'ai' && !(await cache.get('ai_working_notice'))) {
        await cache.set('ai_working_notice', 'true');
        await cache.remove('ai_last_read_error');
        await flutterBridge.showToast('AI角色识别正在工作');
      }

      let dialogueId = 0;
      for (const item of batch) {
        const rendered = [];
        for (let segmentIndex = 0; segmentIndex < item.segments.length; segmentIndex++) {
          const segment = item.segments[segmentIndex];
          let profile;
          if (segment.type === 'dialogue') {
            dialogueId += 1;
            profile = dialogueProfiles[dialogueId] || {
              type: 'dialogue', speaker: '未命名角色', gender: 'unknown', age: 'unknown', emotion: 'neutral', intensity: 0.3
            };
            const before = item.segments[segmentIndex - 1];
            const after = item.segments[segmentIndex + 1];
            const boundaryContext = {
              before: before && before.type === 'narrator' ? before.text : '',
              after: after && after.type === 'narrator' ? after.text : ''
            };
            if (lastFinalizedDialogueProfile && !hasSpeakerCue(boundaryContext)) {
              profile = {
                ...profile,
                speaker: lastFinalizedDialogueProfile.speaker,
                gender: lastFinalizedDialogueProfile.gender,
                age: lastFinalizedDialogueProfile.age
              };
            }
            lastFinalizedDialogueProfile = profile;
          } else {
            profile = {
              type: 'narrator', speaker: '旁白', gender: 'male', age: 'young',
              ...normalizeProsody(dialogueProfiles._narration)
            };
          }
          rendered.push({
            text: segment.text,
            profile: profile,
            voice: await resolveVoice(profile, item.settings)
          });
        }
        await updateChapterMemory(item.text, rendered, dialogueProfiles._source);
        item.resolve(rendered);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (!waitedForFinalize) await waitForPreviousFinalize;
      batch.forEach(item => item.reject(error));
    } finally {
      finishFinalize();
      activeRoleBatches -= 1;
      if (pendingRoleBatch.length && !roleBatchTimer) {
        roleBatchTimer = setTimeout(flushRoleBatch, 0);
      }
    }
  }

  // 阅读 App 调用的核心入口，不可删除或改名。
  async function getttsurl(speakText, speechRate) {
    const text = String(speakText || '').trim();
    const settings = await readSettings();
    const segments = splitSpeechSegments(text);
    if (!settings.aiEnabled && segments.some(item => item.type === 'dialogue')) {
      const noticed = await cache.get('ai_disabled_notice');
      if (!noticed) {
        await cache.set('ai_disabled_notice', 'true');
        await flutterBridge.showToast('AI尚未测试启用，当前使用本地角色判断');
      }
    }
    const rendered = await scheduleRolePreparation(text, segments, settings);

    await flutterBridge.log(
      '本段配音：' + rendered.map(item => item.profile.speaker + '=' + item.voice).join('，')
    );
    return JSON.stringify(await buildMultiVoiceRequest(rendered, speechRate, settings, text));
  }

  async function setAiEnabled(enabled) {
    await cache.set('ai_role_enabled', enabled ? 'true' : 'false');
    if (!enabled) {
      await cache.remove('ai_disabled_notice');
      await cache.remove('ai_working_notice');
    }
    await flutterBridge.showToast(enabled ? '请使用“测试并启用AI”' : '已停用 AI，改用本地判断');
  }

  async function clearRoleCache() {
    lastFinalizedDialogueProfile = null;
    await cache.remove('ai_speaker_voice_map_v2');
    await cache.remove('ai_speaker_voice_map_v3');
    await cache.remove('ai_speaker_voice_map_v4');
    await cache.remove('ai_character_roster_v2');
    await cache.remove('ai_character_roster_v3');
    await cache.remove('ai_character_roster_v4');
    await cache.remove('ai_recent_context');
    await cache.remove('ai_chapter_memory_v3');
    await cache.remove('ai_chapter_memory_v4');
    await flutterBridge.showToast('角色和上下文缓存已清空');
  }

  // 返回非 http 内容时，阅读 App 会把下面的 JSON 显示成设置弹窗。
  async function getloginurl() {
    const models = parseObject(await cache.get('ai_model_list'), []);
    const info = parseObject(await cache.getLoginInfo(), {});
    const currentModel = String((await cache.get('ai_selected_model')) || info['AI模型'] || DEFAULTS.aiModel);
    const ui = [
      {name: 'AI接口', type: 'text'},
      {name: 'AI密钥', type: 'password'},
      {name: 'AI模型', type: 'text'},
      {name: '获取模型', type: 'button', action: 'fetchAiModels()', style: {layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.5}},
      {name: '测试并启用AI', type: 'button', action: 'testAndEnableAI()', style: {layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.5}},
      {name: '状态/当前模型', type: 'button', action: 'showAiStatus()', style: {layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.34}},
      {name: '停用AI', type: 'button', action: 'setAiEnabled(false)', style: {layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.33}},
      {name: '清空角色', type: 'button', action: 'clearRoleCache()', style: {layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.33}}
    ];
    for (const model of models.slice(0, 30)) {
      ui.push({
        name: (model === currentModel ? '✓ ' : '') + model,
        type: 'button',
        action: 'setAiModel(' + JSON.stringify(model) + ')',
        style: {layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.5}
      });
    }
    return JSON.stringify(ui);
  }

  async function login() {}

  // 显式挂到 window，兼容使用反射查找入口函数的阅读 App WebView。
  window.getttsurl = getttsurl;
  window.getloginurl = getloginurl;
  window.login = login;
  window.setAiEnabled = setAiEnabled;
  window.clearRoleCache = clearRoleCache;
  window.fetchAiModels = fetchAiModels;
  window.setAiModel = setAiModel;
  window.showAiStatus = showAiStatus;
  window.testAndEnableAI = testAndEnableAI;
</script>
